articles.title: How a Kid's Obsession with Holograms Led to a Fleet of Ocean Spy Bots
articles.summary: A hidden hot spot in the Caribbean supercharged Hurricane Melissa in 2025, catching everyone off guard. Now, MIT alum Ravi Pappu is deploying swarms of low-cost, autonomous sensors that dive deep to reveal the ocean's invisible threats. His 3-foot-long devices could revolutionize everything from storm prediction to whale tracking.

articles.title: MIT's 25-Year Dorm-Room Revolution: When Student Projects Incubate the Founders
articles.summary: An Apple Watch app that silently alerts caregivers when a nonverbal person needs help just won $20,000 at MIT's IDEAS showcase. The event celebrated 25 years of social ventures, from a pillbox that reshaped India's tuberculosis policy to new climate innovations. A $150,000 gift aims to build a social-impact investor ecosystem on campus.

articles.title: She Made Garbage Trucks Dance: The Unseen Labor Behind Mierle Ukeles's Art
articles.summary: A new documentary, Maintenance Artist, spotlights Mierle Laderman Ukeles, who turned mopping and mothering into a radical art form. As artist-in-residence at NYC's sanitation department for 40 years, she shook hands with every worker and made a ballet of garbage trucks. The film asks: what if the people who clean up after us were the stars?
